title: Deklean Korgad: invisible bridge
summary: Earn Deklean's help and follow his marked route across the invisible bridge.
overview: Earn Deklean's help and follow his marked route across the invisible bridge.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Follow the guide and beacons carefully instead of using the visible false bridge.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Complete Deklean's requested proof and supplies turn-in to begin the bridge route.
As he advances, he places beacons along the safe crossing.
After the route ends he starts a short despawn timer; combat changes his cleanup timing.
